class.name: LensFlare
class.brief_description: The list of elements that make up one lens flare.
class.description: A [LensFlare] is an ordered list of [LensFlareElement]s: the glow around the source, the ghosts strung out across the frame, the halo, the anamorphic streak. Assign one to a [LensFlare3D], which supplies the source's position, colour, intensity and occlusion. The same [LensFlare] can be shared by any number of [LensFlare3D] nodes. Each node keeps its own copy of the element data on the rendering server, so sharing costs nothing at draw time. Elements are drawn in list order. That only matters for elements using [constant LensFlareElement.BLEND_MODE_SCREEN], since additive ones give the same result whatever order they arrive in. A new [LensFlare] is empty, the way a new [Curve3D] is. [method create_default] returns the classic eight element flare to start from instead.

method.name: add_element
method.description: Appends an element to the end of the list.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Returns the classic eight element flare: a corona and a nova on the source, an anamorphic streak, a halo, two runs of iris ghosts and a pair of discs past the centre of the screen. It is built from the flare textures bundled with the engine (the [code]TYPE_BUILTIN_*[/code] entries of [enum LensFlareElement.Type]) and is meant to be edited rather than used as is.

method.name: create_procedural
method.description: Returns the same eight element flare as [method create_default], drawn from the analytic shapes instead of the bundled textures. It costs no texture memory and stays sharp at any resolution, at the cost of the grain and asymmetry a photographed element has.

method.name: get_element_count
method.description: Returns the number of elements in the flare.

members.member: The elements this flare draws, in the order they are drawn.
